ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the picture, a set of fixed solar photovoltaic panels can be seen, the panel surfaces are installed at an incline, and the supports are arranged in rows; the question states that the arrow in the picture indicates the train's direction of travel. Then reason: Tibet is located in the Northern Hemisphere, and fixed photovoltaic panels usually incline toward the south in order to obtain more solar radiation, so the side that the photovoltaic panels face and incline toward can be determined as south. After establishing the directional framework in the picture on this basis, then look at the arrow indicating the train's direction of travel; its direction is equivalent to pointing from southwest toward northeast, so the train was most likely traveling toward the northeast.

raw_record.question_text:
The picture below is a landscape image of solar power generation in Tibet taken by a tourist on a train; the arrow in the picture indicates the train's direction of travel. Read the picture and answer: when this tourist was taking the picture, what direction was the train's direction of travel most likely?

<image1>

method.method_draft: Use the solar-panel tilt as a compass. In the photo, identify the side toward which the panels face/tilt; label that direction as south because Tibetan fixed photovoltaic panels face south. Then place the train arrow on this local compass frame. The arrow points along the northeast direction, so the train was most likely moving northeast.
